app.name: BewerbungsPilot
app.tagline: Your assistant for job applications in Germany

home.title: Welcome to BewerbungsPilot
home.intro: BewerbungsPilot finds job offers in Germany that fit you, writes your application documents and helps you keep track of every application.
home.nextBody: Your profile, the job search, application packages and sending are being built right now. The guide already shows every step.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: A few short steps and BewerbungsPilot is ready for you. First choose the language of the app. You can change it at any time.

claude.title: Connect Claude
claude.intro: BewerbungsPilot uses Claude Code on your computer to read job offers and write your documents.

notInstalled.title: Claude Code is not installed yet
notInstalled.step2: Run the BewerbungsPilot installer again — it installs Claude Code for you.
notInstalled.step3: Start BewerbungsPilot with the desktop shortcut and come back to this step.

notLoggedIn.title: Please sign in to Claude
notLoggedIn.step2: Sign in with your Claude account in the window that opens (a browser page may open too).
notLoggedIn.step3: When you are signed in, close that window and click "Check again".

error.title: Claude did not answer
error.hint: Check your internet connection and click "Check again".

profile.title: Your profile
profile.body: Here you will upload your CV, and Claude will ask a few short questions to complete your profile.

email.title: Your email
email.body: Here you will connect your email so BewerbungsPilot can send the applications you approved.

done.title: All set
done.body: The basics are ready. Open the guide at any time to see what comes next.

guide.title: How it works
guide.intro: Seven steps from installation to your next job interview. Steps marked "Coming soon" are not available yet.

install.title: Installation
install.what: The installer puts BewerbungsPilot and Claude Code on your computer and creates a desktop shortcut.
install.todo: Nothing more — you have already done this. Start the app with the desktop shortcut.

profile.title: Profile
profile.what: Your CV, skills and wishes — the basis for every application. Nothing is ever made up.
profile.todo: Upload your CV and answer a few short questions.

email.title: Email
email.what: Applications are sent from your own email address.
email.todo: Enter your email address and a special app password — we show you how to create one in 3 steps.

search.title: Job search
search.what: BewerbungsPilot searches the job board of the Federal Employment Agency and picks offers that fit your profile. You can also paste an offer you found yourself.
search.todo: Click "Search now" or switch on the daily search.

review.title: Review and approve
review.what: For every fitting offer you get a cover letter, a tailored CV, notes about the company and interview tips.
review.todo: Read the documents, change what you like and approve the application.

send.title: Sending
send.what: Only the applications you approved are sent — never anything else.

statuses.title: Track your applications
statuses.what: See at a glance where you applied, who answered and how your applications are going.
statuses.todo: Mark replies such as an invitation or a rejection — BewerbungsPilot helps you answer.

info.languageSwitcher: Changes the language of the app. Documents for employers use the language of the job offer.
info.claudeTest: Sends a short test question to Claude to check that everything works.
info.restartIntro: Shows the welcome steps again. Your data stays as it is.
info.quit: Stops BewerbungsPilot on this computer. Start it again with the desktop shortcut.

quit.title: BewerbungsPilot has been closed
quit.body: You can close this tab now. To start again, use the BewerbungsPilot shortcut on your desktop.

CLAUDE_NOT_INSTALLED.hint: Run the BewerbungsPilot installer again — it installs Claude Code for you.

CLAUDE_NOT_LOGGED_IN.message: You are not signed in to Claude.
CLAUDE_NOT_LOGGED_IN.hint: Open Settings and click "Open sign-in window".

LLM_TIMEOUT.message: Claude took too long to answer.
LLM_TIMEOUT.hint: Please try again in a moment.

LLM_BAD_OUTPUT.message: Claude's answer could not be understood.
LLM_BAD_OUTPUT.hint: Please try again. If it keeps happening, restart the app.

LLM_FAILED.message: Claude could not finish the task.
LLM_FAILED.hint: Check your internet connection and try again.

LLM_CANCELLED.hint: Start it again whenever you like.

DATA_WRITE_FAILED.message: Your changes could not be saved.
DATA_WRITE_FAILED.hint: Check that your disk is not full and try again.

BAD_REQUEST.message: Something in the request was not right.
BAD_REQUEST.hint: Reload the page and try again.

NOT_FOUND.hint: Go back to the home page.

SERVER_UNREACHABLE.hint: Start it again with the shortcut on your desktop.

UNKNOWN.hint: Please try again. If it keeps happening, restart the app.
